name: Imports Module
description: This module's code imports that module: a fact about the code, not about a run, drawn between the modules of one scope or across scopes alike. An import of a standard-library or third-party module is not drawn here; that is a package dependency (REQUIRES_PACKAGE) and a second copy would disagree. One pair of modules has one edge, whose import_count states how many import statements there are. A reference, not containment.

import_count.description: The number of import statements in the importing module that name the imported module. At least 1: an import that does not exist is not an edge.
